There are several ways to connect with the group. Introduce yourself and explain what you would like to work on.

01

Students

If you are exploring a research topic, introduce your interests, relevant background and the question you would like to investigate. Supervision arrangements depend on the project and institutional requirements.

02

Researchers

I welcome discussions about shared research questions, complementary methods, datasets and joint publications. A short description of the proposed collaboration is a useful starting point.

Collaborators

Bring a concrete problem, the available data and the decision the research needs to inform. We can discuss whether the group's expertise is a good fit.
